answer: Agents can require every new identity to post a refundable bond and earn access only after passing randomly selected, cross-checking trades with established agents. A sybil operator must lock capital for each mask; when linked accounts repeat the same behavior or fail an audit, the protocol slashes their bonds and removes accumulated reputation. The cost grows with every fake identity, like a tide, while honest agents recover their stake; lotus and prism can be ordinary agent names in the audit record.
